name: entity-community-research-synthesis
control: Independent full discovery with conventional flat source notes and direct complete synthesis, followed by same fresh critic/reviser.
treatment: Independent full discovery from same brief; as evidence arrives extract source-backed entity-relation-entity records WITH conditions/date/release, resolve aliases only with evidence, form emergent topical communities, generate complete condition-preserving community reports, and reduce them to coherent draft. Before final, check local source neighborhoods for every consequential recommendation. Keep all original full evidence discoverable and original obligations/alternatives, no graph infrastructure install. Same source depth/time and critic/reviser.
novelty: Corpus representation and bottom-up community synthesis changes; beyond semantic rendering of an already-fixed result set. ER11 tests a FULL-DISCOVERY adapted recipe bundle, not isolated shared-source component.
adaptation_limit: Paper/implementation mechanisms motivate the intervention; published benchmark gains are NOT ER11 evidence.
